title: Build vs buy software: what 2026 data says
takeaways: India software spending will grow 17.6% to $24.7 billion in 2026.
75% of Indian enterprises hit SaaS implementation delays.
Average SaaS rollout runs 57% over time, 43% over cost.
Firms leave 36% of SaaS licenses unused.
Large IT projects run 45% over budget on average.
